in_marathi.name: Gourav
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gourav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gourav is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Gaur' which means 'dawn'. The name Gourav is bestowed upon a child who is believed to bring wisdom and knowledge to the world, like the dawn brings light to the world.
